bio: Housed in the swanky Mandarin Oriental Geneva, this restaurant rolls out modern, vibrant food signed by Yotam Ottolenghi, acknowledged guru of Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cuisines. The menu, devised to be shared, features dishes like a cardamon-flavoured melt-in-the-mouth shoulder of lamb or crunchy Mammole artichoke served with velvety hummus and a spicy sauce. The delicacy of the food is further enhanced by exquisite plating and a contemporary decor in which a central bar sets the tone of the establishment’s relaxed mood. A first-class selection of wines and cocktails adds the final flourish to a casual dining experience with friends or colleagues in a stylish, yet refreshingly unstuffy location....
